name: ch2010structure
summary: A multi-currency, multi-timeframe EA that trades five currency pairs (USDCHF, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, USDJPY, EURGBP) using a class-based architecture. It executes day trades on new daily bars and intraday trades on new 30-minute bars, with built-in order validation and volume capping logic.
summary_zh: 这是一个多货币、多周期EA，使用类架构交易五个货币对（USDCHF、GBPUSD、AUDUSD、USDJPY、EURGBP）。在新日线形成时执行日内交易，在新30分钟线形成时执行日内短线交易，并内置订单验证和成交量限制逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多周期策略，在日线上进行日间交易决策，在M30上进行日内短线交易决策。策略核心封装在CExp类中，通过getTP()获取止盈、getVol()获取交易量、getOrderType()获取订单类型、getDB()获取某个基准值来决定入场条件。出场条件通过getTP()返回的止盈价格实现。仓位管理方面，DebugOrderSend函数实现了严格的仓位控制：单一方向总持仓量不超过15手，单笔最大5手，最小0.1手，且限制挂单总数为12个。资金管理通过检查SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN和SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX确保交易量合规。然而，代码中未见到明确的止损逻辑，这是一个重大风险隐患。IsNewBar函数确保每个周期只在第一个tick执行交易逻辑，避免了重复开仓的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-timeframe strategy, making day trading decisions on new daily bars and intraday trading decisions on new M30 bars. The strategy core is encapsulated in the CExp class, which determines entry conditions through getTP() for take-profit, getVol() for trade volume, getOrderType() for order type, and getDB() for a baseline value. Exit conditions are realized via the take-profit price returned by getTP(). Position sizing is managed by the DebugOrderSend function with strict controls: total directional exposure capped at 15 lots, single trade maximum of 5 lots, minimum of 0.1 lot, and pending orders limited to 12 total. Money management ensures volume compliance by checking SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN and SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX. However, no explicit stop-loss logic is visible in the code, which represents a significant risk. The IsNewBar function ensures trading logic executes only on the first tick of each new bar, preventing duplicate entries.

parameters.name: MaxTotalVolume
parameters.description: 单方向最大总持仓手数
parameters.description_en: Max total volume per direction in lots

pros: 多货币对分散交易，降低单一品种风险
内置订单调试函数，便于排查交易执行问题
仓位控制逻辑完善，有总持仓和单笔上下限限制
使用IsNewBar确保每个K线只执行一次，避免重复开仓
面向对象架构设计，CExp类封装使代码可复用
pros_en: Built-in debug order functions facilitate troubleshooting trade execution issues
Comprehensive position sizing with total exposure and per-trade limits
IsNewBar check ensures one execution per bar, preventing duplicate entries
Object-oriented architecture with CExp class enables code reuse across instruments
cons: 未见明确的止损逻辑，存在无限亏损风险
策略核心方法(getTP/getVol/getOrderType/getDB)实现未展示，无法评估策略有效性
IsNewBar函数中用int变量存储period索引，仅支持两个周期，扩展性差
DebugOrderCheck和DebugOrderSend有重复的验证逻辑，违反DRY原则
硬编码的魔术数字（12、15、5、0.1）缺乏参数化配置
cons_en: No visible stop-loss logic, exposing positions to unlimited loss risk
Core strategy methods (getTP/getVol/getOrderType/getDB) are not shown, making strategy validity unverifiable
IsNewBar uses an int index for only two periods, poor scalability for additional timeframes
Duplicated validation logic between DebugOrderCheck and DebugOrderSend violates DRY principle
Hard-coded magic numbers (12, 15, 5, 0.1) lack parameterized configuration
improvements: 添加明确的止损逻辑，每笔交易都应设置止损价格
将硬编码的数值提取为可配置的输入参数
改进IsNewBar函数，使用映射或动态数组支持任意周期数量
improvements_en: Add explicit stop-loss logic so every trade has a defined maximum loss
Extract hard-coded numeric constants into configurable input parameters
Refactor IsNewBar to use a map or dynamic array supporting arbitrary timeframe counts

risk_points: 缺少止损机制，持仓可能面临巨额亏损
多货币对同时交易可能导致相关性风险集中
总持仓上限15手在极端行情下可能产生重大损失
risk_points_en: Absence of stop-loss exposes positions to potentially catastrophic losses
Simultaneous multi-currency trading can concentrate correlated risk
15-lot total position cap can still produce significant losses in extreme markets

summary_en: A multi-currency, multi-timeframe EA that trades five currency pairs (USDCHF, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, USDJPY, EURGBP) using a class-based architecture. It executes day trades on new daily bars and intraday trades on new 30-minute bars, with built-in order validation and volume capping logic.
